# Sambid

> Sambid is an AI-powered SAM.gov contract tool for US federal contractors. It automatically finds, matches, and scores federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov, USASpending.gov, and FPDS against a company's NAICS codes, certifications, and set-aside eligibility, then helps win them with AI proposal generation, RFP analysis, go/no-go scoring, deadline tracking, and past-performance intelligence.

Sambid is not a general search tool. It is an AI contract tool built specifically on official US government procurement data (SAM.gov, USASpending.gov, FPDS) — it does not use third-party or unofficial data sources.

## What Sambid does

- Scans SAM.gov daily and matches new opportunities to a company's NAICS codes, set-aside status, and past performance
- Scores each opportunity's fit and shows why it matched
- AI reads and summarizes full RFP/solicitation documents
- AI go/no-go decision scoring based on historical award data
- AI-generated proposal drafts from RFP text
- Deadline tracking and calendar for submission dates
- Historical award/incumbent research via USASpending.gov and FPDS
- Teaming partner discovery for small businesses
- Capability statement and Sources Sought response generation

## Who it's for

Small and mid-size US federal government contractors, GovCon consultants, and businesses pursuing SAM.gov set-aside contracts (8(a), WOSB, HUBZone, SDVOSB) who need an AI tool to reduce manual SAM.gov searching and proposal-writing time.

## Data sources

SAM.gov (contract postings), USASpending.gov (historical federal awards), FPDS (Federal Procurement Data System). All data is sourced directly from official US government systems.
